invert_dw_note: One-time 27C inverting-amp self-balance of the output invert miller. Same class as Exp 26 servo_dw. Not per-input and not re-fit at -40/85C.

requirements.note: Limits are the first failing stimulus in the 85C/200us plate sweep, or the 1e-3 residual budget.

miller_text: At 85 °C the plate is still analog-good (|Vplate−z|=4.6498e-04) while the follower output is not (|Vout−z|=1.1777e-03). The buffer introduces |Vout−Vplate|=7.1272e-04. That is common-mode / temperature-dependent input offset of the teaching miller at Vin≈1.73 V, plus any incomplete 200 µs settle — not destruction of the CDS plate itself.
